limitations: Accepts only UVM bytes and returns one M3 or M3A artifact. It has no dependency on PIE or other native codecs.

Mixed rigid draws owned by existing skin joints preserve animation via inverse-bind geometry and existing joint slots. Uniform vertex-layout padding admits only unused UV/tangent inputs; sampled missing inputs refuse.
Target-only BlizzardM3 schema 1 residual fields are consumed when required; reconstructible scene data comes from common glTF/UVM structures.

Material policy is strict by default. Explicit base-color-coverage approximates foreign shaders and common programs with unsupported scene-environment bindings using glTF base color and OPAQUE/MASK/BLEND coverage, reporting omitted shader/PBR/reflection behavior. Texture alpha factors are independent of RGB factors. Non-grey textured RGB factors are lowered to owned vertex colors with RGBA8 loss notes while preserving alpha. Mirrored/transformed UVs and embedded/remote images are refused.
